summary: Iteration 3 (backend + frontend). BOTH iteration-3 changes verified working. (A) App-boot regression: NO blank/white screen, NO Metro bundling errors on web preview - platform-split StreamPlayer (StreamPlayer.web.tsx = expo-video only) correctly avoids importing react-native-vlc-media-player on web so the JS bundle loads. TV Guide renders with 688 epg-channel-* rows in timeline mode and 82 box-channel-* cards in box mode. (B) Auto-refresh on launch: backend POST /api/refresh returns 200 with a NEW last_refresh timestamp, channel_count=688, and GET /api/status/source mirrors the new timestamp (verified via new pytest test_refresh_updates_timestamp_and_status_reflects_it). store.tsx does GET /api/guide (fast) -> POST /api/refresh -> GET /api/guide (silent) on launch — the UI stays usable throughout with no flicker/crash. Player navigation: tapping epg-channel-* navigates to /player?channelId=..., overlay shows Channel Name + Now/Next, surf rail has 54 surf-* items, tapping a surf-* item switches channel and stays on player, player-back-btn returns to the guide. As documented and expected on web preview, the expo-video fallback cannot decode external HLS/TS so the 'Unable to play this stream' overlay + working player-retry-btn appear (message correctly reads 'Live playback needs the installed app build — not the Expo Go preview' because vlcAvailable=false on web) — NOT counted as failure per review_request. Quick regression: mode-timeline-btn / mode-box-btn toggle works, chip filters work (chip-All, chip-Sports etc.), Search/Favorites/Settings tabs all load without errors, settings-refresh-btn triggers refresh without crash. Pre-existing pointerEvents deprecation warning still present (non-blocking). Box card nested-Pressable UX from iteration 2 unchanged — center tap opens ProgramModal, which is documented existing behavior; the outer box-channel-* Pressable still exists and its top-strip does navigate to /player, so navigation is NOT broken.

issues: Carried over from iter 2 (not a regression): the box card body is a nested Pressable stack — tapping the middle 'now title' / 'Next' line opens ProgramModal rather than navigating to /player. The outer box-channel-* Pressable navigates, but only its narrow top / non-nested area is reachable. Consider hoisting navigation to the outer wrapper by making inner rows non-Pressable, or add distinct testIDs (e.g. box-open-<id>) for the navigation-only affordance.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; carried over from iter 1 & 2. Reference: /app/frontend/app/player.tsx:79 (centerOverlay uses pointerEvents inside style object which is fine, but the warning still fires elsewhere).

action_items: OPTIONAL: silence the pointerEvents deprecation warning by auditing any remaining prop usage and moving to style.pointerEvents.
OPTIONAL (iter 2 carryover): make the outer BoxGrid card the sole Pressable so a tap anywhere on box-channel-* navigates to /player (current design opens ProgramModal on middle taps).
critical_code_review_comments: Platform split works: StreamPlayer.web.tsx cleanly avoids the RN internal import that broke web bundling before — confirmed by clean boot and 0 bundle errors in console.
store.tsx auto-refresh order is correct — cached guide first (fast paint), then force refresh, then silent reload; UI stays usable during the ~5-15s import.
server.py POST /api/refresh + get /api/status/source correctly advance and mirror last_refresh (added new pytest to lock this in).
Player fallback UX is clear on web preview — the 'installed app build' hint is only shown when vlcAvailable=false, which is exactly the web case.
Backend cache TTL is 30m but /api/refresh bypasses it with force=True — matches the on-launch use-case.
No mongodb _id leakage; all responses clean.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 pytest incl. new auto-refresh timestamp test)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows on web preview (video decode not testable in preview by design)
